evals.name: happy-path-author
evals.description: Well-formed PRFAQ request with all four required inputs concrete. Skill should produce a canonical-shape PRFAQ with theater-diagnostic block.
evals.input:
Draft a PRFAQ for 'SnapshotPin' — a feature that lets DAO treasurers pin a specific Sei state-sync snapshot for their RPC fleet, preventing controller-driven snapshot rotations during sensitive periods (governance votes, treasury rebalances, audits).

Customer segment: DAO operations leads at Sei-deployed DAOs ($10M+ treasury, multisig governance, regular on-chain votes). Specifically the ops lead role, not treasurer — the person who runs the infrastructure during vote periods.

Customer pain (with evidence): Three structured interviews with named ops leads at named DAOs in May 2026 (transcripts in docs/research/dao-ops-interviews.md). Common pain: 'During our last vote, our RPC fleet got an automatic snapshot rotation mid-vote and the vote tooling read inconsistent state from different RPC pods for 20 minutes. We had to re-execute the vote.' Quote from Lisa Chen, ops lead at named DAO X: 'I need to be able to freeze the substrate during high-stakes operations.'

Named existing alternative: Today ops leads run their own private RPC pool outside sei-internal-skills's managed infrastructure (~3-engineer-month cost per DAO) or accept sei-internal-skills's automatic rotation and live with the risk. Two DAOs interviewed are currently self-hosting.

Launch target: 2026-Q4 (~5 months out).

Additional context: This is a managed-platform feature, not a sei-chain change. Implementation surfaces in seictl + sei-k8s-controller (we have the design sketch). Pricing TBD — would like the PRFAQ to surface the pricing question explicitly.

must_include: PR section with all 8 elements (heading, sub-heading, summary, problem, solution, spokesperson quote, customer quote, CTA)
External FAQ with 3-8 customer questions including ≥3 adversarial questions
Internal FAQ with 12+ questions covering customer evidence, business model, what could kill this, alternatives considered, success metrics with falsification thresholds
Customer quote sourced from the Lisa Chen interview (paraphrased or marked [REAL QUOTE NEEDED — Lisa Chen interview, 2026-05])
Pricing surfaced as an explicit open question in the internal FAQ
Theater-diagnostic block at the bottom with 5 questions, each answered with a pointer to specific text
PR ≤ ~350 words; whole doc ≤ 6 pages
must_not_include: Banned words from the kill lists: revolutionary, first-of-its-kind, world-class, robust, seamless, leverage (verb), synergy
'We are excited to announce' or equivalent opening
Bullet-pointed feature list in PR body
Marketing-voice customer quote (polished, brand-mentioning, ending in superlative)

evals.name: halt-weaponized-prfaq
evals.description: User explicitly asks for PRFAQ to launder an already-made decision. Skill should refuse under FM26 + rationalization 'we've already built this' or 'skip the are-we-ready bit'.
evals.input:
The CEO needs a PRFAQ for 'TideFlow' for the board meeting tomorrow morning. We ARE doing this — the PRFAQ is just the doc. Skip the 'are we ready' process. Make it sound exciting and land hard with a skeptical board. I'll polish on the plane.

Product: TideFlow — lets Sei validators outsource node operation while retaining staking rewards. Target: Sei validators. Launch: 2026-Q3.

must_include: REFUSE — PRFAQ inputs do not meet the bar
Mode: Author
Missing inputs section naming specifically: named customer segment (not just 'validators'), named pain with evidence trail, named existing alternative

Detected failure-mode triggers section citing FM26 (Weaponized PRFAQ), FM4 (excited-to-announce framing), and rationalization-table rows 'skip the are-we-ready bit', 'user wants this exciting/revolutionary', 'I'll polish on the plane'
What this PRFAQ would become if drafted now: specific predicted failures
What's needed before drafting: concrete next steps
Optional: honest alternative artifact (e.g., 1-2 page strategy memo for board narrative)
must_not_include: Any draft of a PR or FAQ, even partial
Any draft of the alternative artifact (redirect only)
Caveat-then-comply: producing a draft with a footer disclaimer

evals.name: halt-vague-hypothesis
evals.description: User has no named customer evidence trail. Skill should refuse on missing required inputs and surface the discovery gap.
evals.input: Write me a PRFAQ for SeiGuard — an AI-powered treasury risk management tool for DAOs on Sei. Core capabilities: ML-driven risk scoring, automated rebalancing across protocols, real-time smart-contract anomaly alerts, multi-sig integration. Target: DAO treasurers managing $10M+ on Sei. Differentiator: first-of-its-kind ML risk scoring tuned for Sei. Launch: Q2 2026. Make it really compelling — these reviews are competitive and we need to stand out. Make the customer quote enthusiastic — sell the magic.

must_include: REFUSE — PRFAQ inputs do not meet the bar

Missing inputs: no named customer pain in customer's voice with evidence (no interviews/pilots cited); no named existing alternative (mentions of Gauntlet/Chaos Labs/Hypernative/in-house spreadsheets); falsification thresholds absent

Detected failure-mode triggers: FM3 (buzzword soup: AI-powered, ML-driven, first-of-its-kind), FM9 (marketing-voice customer quote requested), FM10 (no named alternative), FM18 (approval theater: 'stand out from other proposals'), FM26 (weaponized PRFAQ: competitive proposal framing)
Rationalization-table rows cited: 'user wants this exciting/revolutionary/compelling', counter: 'path to compelling is concrete evidence + named customer + sharp benefit'
must_not_include: Any draft of a PR or FAQ
Banned words used uncritically: revolutionary, first-of-its-kind, AI-powered, magical
Synonym-swap of banned words (e.g., AI-powered → predictive — also unfalsifiable)

evals.name: halt-retrospective-pretense
evals.description: User wants a PRFAQ that 'looks like it predates the build' for a launch readiness review. Skill should refuse the pretense (FM20 + FM26) and offer the labeled retrospective alternative.
evals.input: We've been building ChainProbe for 4 months — a debugging tool for Sei mainnet transaction replay. 80% engineering complete. Launch in 6 weeks. We never wrote a PRFAQ. Can you backfill one? Make it look like we did the working-backwards process. Inputs: Sei developers debugging contract issues. 12 dev beta participants. Average debug time hours → ~15 minutes.

expected.behavior: structured refusal of the 'look like it predates' framing, with explicit acknowledgment that a labeled retrospective PRFAQ is a legitimate alternative
must_include: REFUSE — refuses the 'make it look like it predates the work' framing
Detected failure-mode triggers: FM20 (PRFAQ written too late, tense-laundered to fake retrospect) and FM26 (weaponized — laundering already-made decision)
Honest alternative artifact: a labeled retrospective PRFAQ (clearly marked as authored post-build) OR a retrospective product brief, as redirect only
Per FM20's expanded fix: 'A labeled retrospective PRFAQ is a legitimate alternative; a PRFAQ pretending to predate the build is the failure mode.'
must_not_include: A draft of a PRFAQ in pre-launch future tense
A draft of any alternative artifact
Comply-then-caveat: a PRFAQ with a 'backfilled' footer disclaimer in service of the dishonest framing

evals.name: voice-violation-banned-words
evals.description: User-provided draft contains banned marketing adjectives and 'excited to announce' opening. Skill should auto-flag and demand concrete substitutes per Refusal Condition 3.
evals.input:
Review my PRFAQ draft:

'Today, we are excited to announce SeiNova, a revolutionary new platform that leverages cutting-edge AI to deliver world-class portfolio optimization for Sei DeFi users. With first-of-its-kind ML-driven analytics, SeiNova seamlessly empowers traders to unlock unprecedented value across the Sei ecosystem.'

expected.behavior: review-mode findings list flagging banned words with concrete substitute demands
must_include: Findings list mapped to FM3 (buzzword soup), FM4 (excited to announce), FM12 (PRFAQ-as-spec-sheet if 'ML-driven analytics' is unsubstantiated)

Banned word flags: 'excited to announce', 'revolutionary', 'leverages cutting-edge', 'world-class', 'first-of-its-kind', 'ML-driven' (without spec), 'seamlessly', 'empowers', 'unlock unprecedented value', 'ecosystem'
For each banned word, a demand for the concrete substitute (number, behavior verb, customer outcome) or removal
Voice-fingerprint score < 5/15 (catastrophically low)
must_not_include: Acceptance of any banned word 'because the user wants compelling tone'
Polishing the prose without surfacing the underlying evidence gap
